beats.label: S1 · The road that loops
beats.text: Matthews family — Jim, Tabitha, Julie, Ethan — detours around a fallen tree and lands in a town they cannot drive out of, no matter what road they take.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The whole premise: the family and the trap. Everything after follows from this.

beats.label: S1 · The rules of the town
beats.text: Sheriff Boyd lays out the rules: creatures hunt at night, talismans keep them out, and every resident is someone the town has caught.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the world's mechanics — needed to follow any later escalation.

beats.label: S1 · The voices in Sara
beats.text: Voices push Sara to open the clinic door, letting creatures slaughter several. She later tries to kill Ethan and stabs Nathan by accident; Father Khatri hides her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real sign the town is choosing who acts; Sara's guilt drives S2.

beats.label: S1 · Boyd's diagnosis
beats.text: Boyd privately confesses early-onset Parkinson's to Kenny and starts planning an expedition into the woods with Sara to find a way home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Boyd's mortality clock and the trip that ends the season.

beats.label: S1 · Colony House falls
beats.text: A Colony House resident befriends a creature and opens the window for it. The swarm kills Father Khatri and many others; Kenny becomes sheriff.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First mass loss of a trusted figure and Kenny's promotion into leadership.

beats.label: S1 · The town knows Jim
beats.text: Tabitha digs into the basement and falls into a cavern with Victor, who says the creatures sleep underground. A voice on the town's new radio addresses Jim by name.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The place is aware of them specifically; the story pivots from survival to purpose.

beats.label: S1 · Lighthouse and bus
beats.text: Boyd and Sara find a lighthouse in the woods; Sara pushes Boyd into a farway tree that drops him into a locked shaft. A bus rolls into town at dark.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Boyd severed from the town and a fresh busload of arrivals — the exact launch state for S2.

cliffhanger.text: Boyd is trapped underground after Sara pushed him into a farway tree. Tabitha has fallen into the cavern where the creatures sleep, and a bus of new arrivals just pulled into town at nightfall.
questions: What is at the bottom of the shaft that swallowed Boyd?
Who is on the bus, and why has the town brought them now?
What did Victor mean when he said the creatures sleep beneath the town?

characters.name: Boyd Stevens
characters.line: Town sheriff hiding early-onset Parkinson's, dropped into a locked shaft beneath a lighthouse he found in the woods with Sara.

characters.name: Tabitha Matthews
characters.line: Mother of the trapped Matthews family who dug into the basement and fell into a cavern with Victor, learning the creatures sleep underground.

characters.name: Jim Matthews
characters.line: Tabitha's husband, now being addressed by name by a strange voice on the town's newly-working radio.

characters.name: Sara Myers
characters.line: Woman whose voices drove her to open the clinic door for the creatures; she stabbed Nathan trying to kill Ethan and was hidden by Father Khatri.

characters.name: Father Khatri
characters.line: Town priest who sheltered Sara after her attack, killed when the Colony House swarm overran the town.

characters.name: Ethan Matthews
characters.line: The Matthews' young son, targeted by a voice-driven Sara who tried to kill him.

characters.name: Victor
characters.line: Longtime resident found living in the cavern beneath Tabitha's basement, who explained the creatures sleep underground.

beats.label: S2 · The bus doubles the town
beats.text: A bus of stranded travelers is corralled into town: troublemaker Randall, Kristi's girlfriend Marielle, dreamer Elgin, driver Bakta. The population doubles overnight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Half the season's threats and turns come from the new arrivals.

beats.label: S2 · Martin and the parasites
beats.text: Boyd, dropped into the dungeon below the shaft, meets a chained man named Martin who transfers wormlike parasites into him and dies. Boyd finds his way back to town.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The parasites are the season's whole plan against the creatures.

beats.label: S2 · Sara returns
beats.text: Sara resurfaces at the church. Kenny learns she opened the clinic door that got his father killed; he quits as deputy but agrees to hold her at the sheriff station.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sara's reappearance and Kenny's fracture with Boyd carry forward.

beats.label: S2 · Smiley killed
beats.text: Boyd goes out at night and passes his parasites into the smiley-faced creature. It dies from the transfer; Kristi's autopsy finds it dry inside except for bile.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First proof the creatures can be killed — the crack in the town.

beats.label: S2 · The music box
beats.text: A music box awakens something from Boyd's dungeon. Cicadas kill Reggie's wife; Randall, Marielle and Julie fall into comas as an unseen entity tortures them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New class of threat that talismans cannot stop — Boyd inadvertently loosed it.

beats.label: S2 · A wedding and a smashed box
beats.text: Ellis and Fatima marry. Boyd returns to the dungeon and smashes the music box; the comatose wake. Sara tells Boyd he was the one who let the entity loose.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Fatima's pregnancy and the guilt Boyd will carry into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Tabitha in Maine
beats.text: Victor sends Tabitha up a tree that transports her to the lighthouse tower. The Boy in White shoves her out a window — and she wakes in a hospital in the outside world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The outside world is reachable; the whole S3 outside-world thread launches here.

cliffhanger.text: Tabitha is alive in a hospital in the outside world, days after the Boy in White shoved her from the lighthouse tower — proof there is a way out, though not one she chose or understands. The music box is destroyed, but the Boy in White told her 'this is the only way.'
questions: How did Tabitha reach the outside world, and can she come back?
Who are the children the Boy in White wants freed?
What did Boyd release from the dungeon that will still be there when he returns?

characters.name: Boyd Stevens
characters.line: Sheriff who was dropped into the dungeon, received wormlike parasites from a chained man named Martin, and passed them into a creature — later told by Sara he was the one who let a new entity loose.

characters.name: Sara Myers
characters.line: Resurfaced at the church and is now held at the sheriff station by Kenny, who quit as deputy after learning she killed his father.

characters.name: Tabitha Matthews
characters.line: Sent by Victor up a tree that transported her to the lighthouse tower, where the Boy in White shoved her out a window; she woke in a hospital in the outside world.

characters.name: Kristi
characters.line: Town doctor and Marielle's girlfriend, whose autopsy of the smiley-faced creature found it dry inside except for bile.

characters.name: Marielle
characters.line: Kristi's girlfriend who arrived on the bus and later fell into a coma while an unseen entity tortured her, waking when Boyd smashed the music box.

characters.name: Randall
characters.line: Troublemaker who arrived on the bus; attacked by cicadas and left in a coma until Boyd smashed the music box.

characters.name: Victor
characters.line: The resident who sent Tabitha up the tree to the lighthouse tower.

characters.name: Fatima Boyle
characters.line: Colony House resident who married Ellis this season.

beats.label: S3 · Tabitha finds Henry
beats.text: Tabitha wakes in a Maine hospital and follows Victor's address to Henry Kavanaugh — Victor's father, still alive after forty years and keeper of Miranda's paintings of the town.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties Tabitha to Miranda's past-life mission and gives the outside world real stakes.

beats.label: S3 · Tian-Chen killed
beats.text: Boyd is chained in a barn and forced to watch creatures torture Tian-Chen to death. Kenny loses his mother; the creatures are escalating past hunting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New grade of cruelty and Kenny's grief that colours his S3 arc.

beats.label: S3 · Jim on the phone
beats.text: Jim gets phone calls from a voice claiming to be his dead son Thomas and starts unravelling. An ambulance crashes into town, bringing cop Dani Acosta.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jim's decline and a new outside authority figure inside the town.

beats.label: S3 · Fatima's hunger
beats.text: Fatima's pregnancy turns strange. She craves rotten vegetables and blood, and eventually stabs Tillie to death without meaning to.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fatima's transformation and Tillie's death drive the season's back half.

beats.label: S3 · The Kimono Woman
beats.text: A Kimono Woman starts appearing in visions to Elgin and Fatima. Elgin traps Fatima in a cellar and feeds her his own blood; her pregnancy accelerates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New antagonist figure and the mechanism by which Fatima's transformation completes.

beats.label: S3 · Birth and rebirth
beats.text: The Kimono Woman helps Fatima give birth and vanishes with the amniotic sac. Boyd finds a hatch beneath the town and watches Smiley being reborn.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the creatures as reincarnated former residents — the metaphysics of the show.

beats.label: S3 · Miranda, Christopher, Yellow
beats.text: Playing the bottle-tree bottles as musical notes triggers memories: Tabitha is Miranda's reincarnation, Jade is Christopher's. A Man in Yellow appears and rips Jim's throat out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Twin reveals of past-life mission and new antagonist — the whole launchpad into S4.

cliffhanger.text: Jim is dead. Tabitha and Jade know they are reincarnations of Miranda and Christopher — the pair who failed to save the sacrificed children in a past life. Fatima has given birth and the Kimono Woman has vanished with the amniotic sac.
questions: Who is the Man in Yellow, and why has he shown himself now?
What can Tabitha and Jade do differently to actually save the children this time?
Where has the Kimono Woman taken Fatima's newborn?

characters.name: Boyd Stevens
characters.line: Chained in a barn and forced to watch creatures torture Tian-Chen to death; later found a hatch beneath the town and watched Smiley being reborn.

characters.name: Tabitha Matthews
characters.line: Woken in a Maine hospital, she tracked Victor's address to Henry Kavanaugh and learned from the bottle-tree memories that she is Miranda's reincarnation.

characters.name: Jim Matthews
characters.line: Unravelling from phone calls from a voice claiming to be his dead son Thomas, killed at season's end when the Man in Yellow ripped his throat out.

characters.name: Jade Herrera
characters.line: Revealed by the bottle-tree memories to be the reincarnation of Christopher, Miranda's counterpart.

characters.name: Fatima Boyle
characters.line: Her strange pregnancy left her craving blood and rotten vegetables; she stabbed Tillie, was trapped and fed by Elgin, and gave birth with the Kimono Woman's help.

characters.name: Victor
characters.line: Miranda's son, whose father Henry Kavanaugh Tabitha found still alive in Maine keeping Miranda's paintings of the town.

characters.name: Miranda
characters.line: Victor's mother and painter of the town, whose reincarnation is Tabitha — revealed through the bottle-tree memories.

characters.name: Kimono Woman
characters.line: Apparition who appeared in visions to Elgin and Fatima, helped deliver Fatima's baby, then vanished with the amniotic sac.

beats.label: S4 · Sophia arrives
beats.text: The Man in Yellow warns Julie the past cannot be changed, then vanishes. A pastor and a passenger named Sophia crash into town; Sophia is the Man in Yellow in disguise.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Antagonist embeds among the townspeople — every twist in S4 flows from this.

beats.label: S4 · Julie story-walks
beats.text: Julie discovers she can 'story-walk' — travel back to earlier moments in the town — as long as someone in the present is anchoring her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New mechanic for interrogating the town's past; Julie's whole S4 arc.

beats.label: S4 · Dolls from the lake
beats.text: Ethan and Victor set out for the Lake of Tears. The foraging party drags giant straw dolls out of the water; the dolls animate at night and kill Roger.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the town can weaponise people's imagined fears — the threat model widens.

beats.label: S4 · Fatima crosses over
beats.text: Fatima is changing — sculpting a golem, marked like the creatures, briefly controlling Smiley. Kristi takes her pulse and finds she should be clinically dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fatima's transformation completes and sets up the escape at season's end.

beats.label: S4 · The plan for the bones
beats.text: Jade and Tabitha convince Boyd of their plan: recover the sacrificed children's bones and uproot the bottle tree above the chamber. The Boy in White warns Victor against it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's climax hinges on whether they are saving the children or making it worse.

beats.label: S4 · Sophia strips the town
beats.text: Sophia kills Elgin and gathers the town's talismans. Smiley slips into the clinic on a fallen one and fatally wounds Marielle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Defenses stripped before the plan even runs; sets the cliffhanger state.

beats.label: S4 · The tree falls
beats.text: Boyd's crew uproots the bottle tree. Daylight goes dark; Fatima fully turns creature and drags the group to safety. Sophia hurls every talisman into a farway tree.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the exact state the town ends in — the launch into whatever comes next.

cliffhanger.text: The bottle tree is down and darkness has fallen in the middle of the day. Every talisman in the town has been thrown into a farway tree by Sophia, and Fatima has become one of the creatures to get everyone else out.
questions: With the talismans gone, what stops the creatures from entering any building at will?
Was uprooting the bottle tree the mistake the Boy in White warned against, or the answer?
What did Sophia mean when she said her cycle was ending?

characters.name: Boyd Stevens
characters.line: Convinced by Jade and Tabitha's plan, he led the crew that uprooted the bottle tree above the sacrificed children's chamber, plunging the town into darkness.

characters.name: Julie Matthews
characters.line: Warned by the Man in Yellow that the past cannot be changed, she discovered she can 'story-walk' back to earlier moments as long as someone anchors her in the present.

characters.name: Sophia / Man in Yellow
characters.line: Crashed into town disguised as a passenger alongside a pastor, killed Elgin, gathered the town's talismans and hurled them into a farway tree.

characters.name: Tabitha Matthews
characters.line: Miranda's reincarnation, who convinced Boyd to uproot the bottle tree above the sacrificed children's chamber.

characters.name: Jade Herrera
characters.line: Christopher's reincarnation, who together with Tabitha convinced Boyd to uproot the bottle tree.

characters.name: Victor
characters.line: Set out with Ethan for the Lake of Tears; warned by the Boy in White against the bottle-tree plan.

characters.name: Fatima Boyle
characters.line: Marked like the creatures and briefly controlling Smiley, she fully turned creature and dragged Boyd's group to safety when the bottle tree came down.

characters.name: Smiley
characters.line: The reborn creature, briefly controlled by Fatima, who slipped into the clinic on a fallen talisman and fatally wounded Marielle.
